definitions.short: Barakel , the father of one of Job's friends
definitions.full: H1292. Barakel בָּרַכְאֵל proper name, masculine ( El doth bless , compare Phoenician ברכבעל , Palmyrene בלברך Vog 117 , Babylonian Bariki-ili Opp Ja 1887 Nov-Dec., 596f. ) father of Elihu Job 32:2 , 6 .
